# POST /api/v1/markdown

Render a markdown document as HTML

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-009`

## Request

**Headers:** `Content-Type`

**Request Body** (`application/json`) — `MarkdownOption`

| Field | Type | Required | Validation |
|-------|------|----------|------------|
| `Text` | string | False |  |
| `Mode` | string | False | one of: empty, markdown, gfm, comment, wiki, file |
| `Context` | string | False |  |
| `Wiki` | boolean | False |  |

## Response

**200** — text/html

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `body` | string | Rendered HTML content |

- **401** — No valid token provided (reqToken middleware)
- **422** — Invalid form binding or unsupported render mode
- **500** — Internal rendering error

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | bind[MarkdownOption] | utility | Deserialize JSON body into MarkdownOption struct; Validate binding |
| 2 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | misc.Markdown | controller | Retrieve form via web.GetForm; Compute mode: util.Iif(form.Wiki, 'wiki', form.Mode) |
| 3 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | common.RenderMarkup | service | Parse urlPathContext to extract owner/repo/ref/treePath; Switch on mode: empty/markdown → NewRenderContextSimpleDocument + markdown.RenderRaw; gfm/file → NewRenderContextRepoFile + markup.Render; comment → NewRenderContextRepoComment + markup.Render; wiki → NewRenderContextRepoWiki + markup.Render; Set UseAbsoluteLink(true) |
| 4 | [modules](../modules/modules.md) | markdown.RenderRaw / markup.Render | utility ⏳ | Parse markdown via goldmark; Sanitize HTML output via bluemonday policy; Pipe-based streaming: render → sanitize → output |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Markdown rendering endpoints require authentication token | authorization | !ctx.IsSigned |
| Deprecated Wiki boolean field overrides Mode field for backward compatibility | business_logic | form.Wiki == true |
| Render mode must be one of: empty, markdown, gfm, comment, wiki, file | validation | mode not in supported set |
| Empty or 'markdown' mode uses simple document rendering (no link processing) | business_logic | mode == "" || mode == "markdown" |

## Error Handling

| Trigger | Status | Response | Retryable |
|---------|--------|----------|-----------|
| Invalid JSON body or missing required fields | 422 | APIError with field name and error | True |
| Mode not in [empty, markdown, gfm, comment, wiki, file] | 422 | HTTP error: unsupported render mode: X | False |
| Unable to find renderer for content | 422 | HTTP error with error message | False |
| Internal markdown rendering failure | 500 | HTTP error: failed to render markup | True |

### Error Paths

- **No token provided** → reqToken middleware → 401
- **Invalid JSON binding** → bind middleware → 422
- **Unsupported render mode** → common.RenderMarkup default case → 422
- **util.ErrInvalidArgument from markup.Render** → common.RenderMarkup → 422
- **Other render error** → common.RenderMarkup → 500
